antiphonae_evangelicae.benedictus: Sústulit Iesus óculos, et clamávit voce magna: Lázare, veni foras.
antiphonae_evangelicae.magnificat: Diligébat autem Iesus Martham, et sorórem eius, et Lázarum.
antiphonae_evangelicae.benedictus_es: Jesús, levantando los ojos a lo alto, gritó con voz potente: «¡Lázaro, sal fuera!»
antiphonae_evangelicae.magnificat_es: Jesús amaba a Marta, a su hermana y a su hermano Lázaro.

source_note: Magnificat/Benedictus antiphons were previously the wrong shared COMMON_HOLY_MEN_WOMEN placeholder text. Replaced with genuine saint-specific text sourced from breviarium-core (Spanish), Latin is a direct faithful translation from the Vulgate underlying the quoted Gospel verses (John 11:5, John 11:41/43). Collect was already correct, unchanged.
collecta: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, cuius Filius in domo beatæ Marthæ dignatus est hospitari, da, quæsumus, ut, eiusdem intercessione, Christo in fratribus nostris fideliter ministrantes, in æde cælesti a te recipi mereamur. Per Dominum.
